definition_de: jemandem zeigen und erklären, wie etwas geht, bis er es selbst kann (meist praktisch, nicht im Unterricht: jdm. Schwimmen, Fahrradfahren beibringen)
example_de: Als ich sechs war, hat mir mein Vater im Park das Fahrradfahren beigebracht.
example_en: When I was six, my father taught me to ride a bike in the park.
visual_idea: Collocation 'jdm. das Fahrradfahren beibringen': a father running beside a child on a bike, one hand holding the saddle. Everyone knows this moment; it shows practical teaching (not 'unterrichten' in a classroom). Video: the father lets go and the child rides alone.
image_prompt: a father running alongside his six-year-old daughter who is riding a small red bicycle on a park path, he bends down and holds the back of the saddle with one hand, the girl wears a helmet and looks ahead with concentration and excitement, green trees and a lawn around them, sunny afternoon, side view
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: a father runs beside his young daughter on a red bicycle on a park path, holding the saddle; after a few steps he lets go and stops, and the girl keeps riding on her own while he raises his arms in joy; camera follows slowly from the side
